auditor_lee: Hi team, ISO fieldwork here. We need end-to-end evidence for the RBAC update and KMS usage during the maintenance window on 2024-11-21. Specifically: approval trail, infra change (Terraform apply), k8s audit lines, cloud key decrypts, and your key policy/rotation statement. Can you package an evidence manifest?

sam_sre: assigning. I will collect the k8s audit slice and CI/Terraform run. Do you want the Okta admin approval screenshot or an export of the Okta audit event?

auditor_lee: Okta audit event export preferred (machine-readable). If you can include a short signed statement from the approver (one-line) that's helpful for ISO A.9 mapping.

opsec_tina: adding that the change touched namespace `inference-prod` and modified `ClusterRoleBinding:inference-deployers`. The Terraform change was `tf-apply-20241121-88` which created a new service account `inference-sa`. We also rotated a KMS key alias/redwood-inf-cache in the same window as a precaution.

devops_raj: I applied the Terraform. PR: GH-3491. Approval: okta_event_id=evt-20241121-99. Terraform output has a plan/apply diff and shows creation of `kubernetes_service_account.inference_sa`. CI job: ci-cd/terraform-apply/3491. Deploy correlator id: deploy.correlation=20241121-3491.

ben_sec: For KMS: primary CMK is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456-7890. Rotation policy: automatic yearly rotation enabled; last rotation 2023-12-10; manual rewrap for cache used ephemeral keys on 2024-11-21T04:10Z. Key policy snapshot will be included.

sam_sre: I will pull Kubernetes audit logs (policy-level) for 2024-11-21 03:45-04:30 UTC and CloudTrail for the same window filtered for KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events. Plan to produce: evidence_manifest.jsonl, timeline.txt, k8s-audit.jsonl, cloudtrail-kms.jsonl, terraform-diff.patch, okta-events.jsonl, checksums.sha256.

auditor_lee: timeline.txt should map: GH-3491 PR merged -> tf-apply-20241121-88 -> kube patch -> KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt. For ISO please also note the control mapping to A.9.2 (user access provisioning), A.12.3 (backup and recovery) and A.10.1 (cryptographic controls).

kd-bot: terraform run completed: tf-apply-20241121-88; approved_by: devops_raj; plan_changes: +1 service account; run_id: pipeline-7723.

sam_sre: example k8s audit (sanitized):
{"stageTimestamp":"2024-11-21T04:05:12Z","verb":"patch","user":{"username":"devops_raj","uid":"U-810"},"objectRef":{"resource":"clusterrolebindings","name":"inference-deployers"},"requestObject":{"changes":"+subjects:[{kind:ServiceAccount,name:inference-sa}]"}}

ben_sec: example CloudTrail KMS event (sanitized):
{ "eventTime": "2024-11-21T04:06:22Z", "eventName": "GenerateDataKey", "userIdentity": {"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-runtime-role/ci-runner"}, "resources": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456-7890"], "requestParameters": {"keyId":"ef12-3456-7890","encryptionContext":{"deploy_id":"20241121-3491"}} }

opsec_tina: good correlation with encryptionContext.deploy_id. Please ensure the output includes a JSON line that highlights that mapping for the auditor.

devops_raj: I will include the GH merge event (sha: d4c3b2a) and the Terraform apply log lines: `Apply complete: 1 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed` along with the run URL. Also adding the Okta approval event export.

sam_sre: small ask from ops: include sha256 checksums for each exported artifact and a short README.md that lists file -> ISO control mapping. I'll compute checksums and produce checksums.sha256.

auditor_lee: also include access list for service accounts created/modified (screenshot or export from k8s rbac query). We need to verify least-privilege.

ben_sec: note about HSM: CMK is AWS KMS with external HSM (CloudHSM) backing. I'll add the KeyPolicy.pdf and the KMS rotation log (audit) showing last rotation operation.

sam_sre: uploading bundle to s3://redwood-audit-bucket/iso-fieldwork/2024-11-21/1769991111_bundle.zip. Contents: README.md, timeline.txt, evidence_manifest.jsonl, k8s-audit.jsonl, cloudtrail-kms.jsonl, terraform-apply.log, okta-events.jsonl, serviceaccount-list.txt, keypolicy.pdf, checksums.sha256. ETA 30 minutes.

auditor_lee: thanks. One extra item: please redact any long-lived secrets in logs and annotate redactions in README.

devops_raj: all logs sanitized and marked. Uploaded and DM'd the presigned link. Link shared in DM.

kd-bot: bundle created: 1769991111_bundle.zip; size: 4.2MB; sha256: b7f9c1...; uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-bucket/iso-fieldwork/2024-11-21/1769991111_bundle.zip.

auditor_lee: received. We'll review and file any follow-ups. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

opsec_tina: post-audit action: add deploy correlation id to all CI stages and KMS encryption_context by default. Filed: SEC-659.

ben_sec: noted; will add to security backlog and include doc updates for key management runbook.

auditor_lee: closing this thread for now. If we need additional raw traces we'll request them. Appreciate the thorough manifest.
